name: convergence-breaker-productive-vs-thrash
title: The convergence breaker cannot distinguish a story surfacing real defects from one thrashing, and its trip reason reads as self-contradictory
description: The advance signal counts advances without regard to what they produced, so a story whose rounds keep closing genuine reviewer findings is frozen on the same evidence as one re-attempting a gate that refuses for the same reason. Separately, the trip reason is built from the delta rather than the raw counter, so a story at count 21 over baseline 0 and one at count 42 over baseline 21 record the identical string advance-count 21>20; combined with the re-baselining that auto-recovery performs, the persisted state reads as though nothing changed between the recovery and the freeze, and predicting remaining headroom from it fails. A third class of advance, forced re-work caused by main moving underneath the story with no finding attached, is misclassified as thrash by the obvious fix. Includes a confirmed uncaught EISDIR in the experience-log reader.
